stories.title: Ole Miss up to No. 4, LSU slides to 10th as 10 SEC teams ranked
stories.summary: Ole Miss moved into the top five with its win over LSU, the Tigers stayed in the top 10, and Florida and Mississippi State cracked the rankings to give the SEC 10 teams in The Associated Press Top 25.

stories.title: Longtime exec Accorsi, architect of Giants' historic SB team, dies at 84
stories.summary: Longtime NFL executive Ernie Accorsi, the architect of the Giants team that pulled off one of the biggest upsets in Super Bowl history, has died. He was 84.

stories.title: Packers lose WR Reed, RT Bako-Bewele to injuries on consecutive plays
stories.summary: Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed and right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele were carted off the field on back-to-back plays Sunday.

stories.title: AL West-leading Rangers lose versatile Quantrill to lat injury
stories.summary: The Rangers put versatile right-hander Cal Quantrill on the 15-day injured list Sunday, a day after he exited following only four batters and 12 pitches because of right lat tightness.

stories.title: Reds place ace Burns on 15-day IL with groin injury
stories.summary: The Reds have placed right-hander Chase Burns on the 15-day injured list with a right groin strain. A first-time All-Star this season, the 23-year-old went 15-3 with a 2.86 ERA.
